primary.title: The Four Voyages of Christopher Columbus
primary.author: Christopher Columbus
primary.rationale: This is a collection of letters and journals attributed to Columbus detailing his voyages. The 'Letter to the Sovereigns' is a key primary document.

primary.title: The Journal of Christopher Columbus
primary.author: Christopher Columbus
primary.rationale: The original journal is lost, but Bartolomé de las Casas created an abridged version. This is a fundamental primary source for his first voyage.

secondary.title: 1491: New Revelations of the Americas Before Columbus
secondary.author: Charles C. Mann
secondary.rationale: While not solely about Columbus, this book provides essential context for the Americas prior to European contact, offering a scholarly re-evaluation of the period.

secondary.title: Columbus: The Four Voyages
secondary.author: Laurence Bergreen
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography that draws on primary sources to provide a detailed account of Columbus's life and expeditions.

secondary.title: The Lost History of the Americas
secondary.author: Ned Blackhawk
secondary.rationale: This book offers a Native American perspective on the history of the Americas, providing critical analysis of the impact of Columbus's voyages.

suggestions.notes: Primary source materials for Columbus are often found in collections and translations, as original documents are rare or lost. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly reputation and focus on re-evaluating the historical narrative surrounding Columbus and his era.
